codes.name: BLOCKED
codes.description: The indicated time slot(s) is(are) blocked.

codes.name: CANCELLED
codes.description: The indicated appointment was stopped from occurring (cancelled prior to starting)

codes.name: COMPLETE
codes.description: The indicated appointment has completed normally (was not discontinued, canceled, or deleted)

codes.name: DC
codes.description: The indicated appointment was discontinued (DC’ed while in progress, discontinued parent appointment, or discontinued child appointment)

codes.name: DELETED
codes.description: The indicated appointment was deleted from the filler application

codes.name: OVERBOOK
codes.description: The appointment has been confirmed; however it is confirmed in an overbooked state

codes.name: PENDING
codes.description: Appointment has not yet been confirmed

codes.name: STARTED
codes.description: The indicated appointment has begun and is currently in progress

codes.name: WAITLIST
codes.description: Appointment has been placed on a waiting list for a paricular slot, or set of slots
